notes: v665 - every holding now shows how much room it has before it sells. Under each position you will see something like '7.7% of room before it sells at $1.200 (trail) - $100.00 of this position - best close $1.500, now 13.3% under it'. It is coloured by how tight it is rather than by profit: green with plenty of room, amber under 8%, red under 3%. A position deep in profit can still be one bad day from selling, and that is exactly what this is for. This matters most on the tested rules, where a 20% trailing stop with no take-profit IS the position - it decides everything, moves every day, and until now was invisible until it fired. You could not tell a holding 2% from being sold from one with 18% of room. The figure uses the same arithmetic the app uses to make a real exit decision - your own manual stop wins outright, otherwise the highest of stop, break-even, trailing stop and ladder lock - so the number you see is the number that acts. If a holding has no stop at all it says so plainly, because nothing will sell it automatically. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
